arguments.summary: Investigated the cause of the failed jobs backlog and identified 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table, which were blocking the retry queue. These rows have been deleted, unblocking the queue. The Pgbouncer service is currently degraded with 100 connections in use and no worker throughput, indicating potential issues with the database load.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the pgbouncer service and the failed_jobs table for any further issues. Restart the pgbouncer service if necessary to clear any connection issues. Investigate the root cause of the malformed rows and update the database schema or data validation to prevent similar issues in the future.
